constructions.title: Days of each spreading season at or above a daily rain total

rain.first_year.is: The first calendar year with a February-April season in the hourly ERA5 record held in `data/raw/weather`.

rain.last_year.is: The last calendar year with a February-April season in that record.

rain.seasons.is: February-April seasons in the record. Each must hold every day of its three months, or the page is refused, so none is partial.

rain.by_threshold.*.mm.is: The daily total a row counts days at. Chosen by the page (`THRESHOLDS_MM` in `scripts/pages/settle.py`); not measured.

rain.by_threshold.*.median_days.is: The median over seasons of the number of days in a season whose total is at or above the row's threshold. One day is one UTC calendar day; a storm spanning two days counts twice, so this counts days, not events.

rain.by_threshold.*.min_days.is: The fewest such days in any one season of the record.

rain.by_threshold.*.max_days.is: The most such days in any one season of the record.

constructions.what: For each daily rain total the page counts at, how many days of a February-April season reach it: the median over the seasons of the record, and the fewest and most.
constructions.model: `rain_days()` sums the hourly `precipitation` values of the Open-Meteo ERA5 files per calendar day of their own clock, $P_d = \sum_{h \in d} p_h$, skipping missing hours; for each year it keeps the days of February, March and April, refuses any season that is not whole (`calendar.monthrange`), and counts $n_{y,t} = \#\{d \in y : P_d \ge t\}$ for each threshold `t`. The median, minimum and maximum of $n_{y,t}$ over the years are stored.
assumptions: The value at the record's grid point stands for rain over Copenhagen: it is the point `scripts/streams.py` names, and a reanalysis grid-cell average, not a gauge.
Days are UTC days: the record's clock is GMT (checked at every build; the page is refused otherwise), so a Danish evening storm can fall on two days.

justified.text: The counts are made from every hour of the fetched record, one raw file at a time, with incomplete seasons refused rather than counted short.
The same hourly record is what the rest of the project reads for rain, so the page's counts and its other rain figures share one source.

gaps: A grid-cell average smooths local downpours, so the counts at the higher thresholds are more likely to understate what one catchment sees; how much is not measured here.
Days are not events: the table cannot say how many separate storms a season holds.
void_if: the raw weather files are refetched for another point or with another time zone
the season months or thresholds are changed without the page's wording following
constructions.licenses: How many days of a February-April season, in this record, reach each daily total - the sample a sampler triggered at that total would see.
constructions.not_licensed: Counts of storms or events, rain at any one catchment, or anything about an autumn control window, which is not counted.
